title: 第七章 白莲花系统第八章 上官枫
content_zh:
首长老诚恳的问一句：“我们能研究他们吗？”
韩紫枫也老诚恳的回答：“你真不怕这群嗷嗷待哺的拆你家？”她转身问其中一个智能机器人管家：“管家，你那里有智能机器人贩卖吗？做研究的那种。”
管家回答：“主人，自信点，但凡他们敢搜索的，但凡他们钱够，我都能给弄出来。”
紫枫脑袋一抽问：“有现实能用的，哆啦A梦的任意门不？”
管家沉默，一直围观这里的霖华仙尊也被这个孩子的脑洞给搞不会啦，管家无语的说：“主人啊，这个真没有啊，还有，那些神奇宝贝什么的，黄金圣衣什么的，也都没有昂，拜托，您说点靠谱的成不，圣衣的话，也是咱东方战神战铠之类的东西昂，武器都是冷兵器昂。”
一群人不厚道的笑啊，他们心里都出现六个大字：这是脑洞问题。
别说，首长们出面，事情还是很快就处理好，至于那个智能机器人管家，则是直接在长街一号这边，在众人的帮助下，顺利的开了一个小超市，子沫身上没啥用的东西，直接摆在柜台上贩卖。
剩下的，直接用电脑搜索，然后跑管家这里，付费提货。只是门口一个大大的招牌：禁止韩家人进店购买物品。
当韩家人知道这个消息的时候，真的又肠子悔青掉的感觉，原来那个丫头，那天是这个意思。只是现在他们要怎么圆这个事儿？
紫枫看着这里的事情已经处理的差不多，想想冲着这里常驻的几个维持秩序的人说：“你们帮忙看着点，我要去开工啦。我希望韩家的事情，你们能出面摆平，我不希望回来看到什么不好的事情，反正，包不包得住贩卖机是你们的问题。”
一群人齐齐点头，紫枫吩咐管家：“如果出意外，自己往回走昂，攻击你的直接秒，别告诉我你连这种降维打击的事情都不会。行啦，行啦，准备开工。”她直接在脑海中问：“亲，人家可以复工啦。”
霖华仙尊有点疑惑的问：“你确定，处理成这样就可以啦？”
紫枫有点淡漠的说：“那些修士，为了一口吃的，不会跟韩家客气的。就算韩家，为了这口利益，也不会轻易妥协的。不过，这些就是他们的问题啦，还有外国的势力，话说，你给那个卖货的智能机器人身上加个禁止，就算信仰有差别，但因果的话，你应该没啥所谓是吧？”
霖华仙尊疑惑：“什么意思？”
紫枫想想说：“就跟信仰的争夺差不多，如果那些天使的信徒，狮子犬信徒，种马信徒，跑来这里买东西，那么你是不是能通过这些，分那些神的信仰？如果能做到的话，这个完全可以整个世界铺开。”
霖华仙尊打一个响指表示：“理解，这个真的可以有，我可以在他们购买的东西上，中下因果种子。”
紫枫淡定的说：“自己看着玩，不过如果是这么个玩法，那么这个机器人现在在的地方，就有点不适合啦。”她想一下问：“亲，咱带暗星操作一波的不？”
霖华仙尊笑着问：“说说你的想法。”
紫枫说：“下波来一个阵法大全，嗯能做到在方圆千里，布下聚灵阵那种，到时候，我建大楼，收房租，这里也是可以接待外籍信仰的，这样你就当卖种子呗。”
霖华仙尊点头说：“这个可以有。”

紫枫说：“那等下复工，我去跟这边高层打一个招呼，毕竟这样的事情，被误会就不太好啦。”
紫枫来到首长的面前，把自己的想法跟首长说明白，淡定的说：“嗯，我上面的那位，也不是白给你们好处的，自然是有些他想要的东西，要不就别要这些好处，要不就出他要的，不过就你们这些凡人，能奉献的东西，绝对物超所值，关键是，真没什么好担心的，你们见不见得到他，还不好说呢。”
首长问：“西方那些人，也是这个待遇？”
紫枫摸着下巴说：“不不不，怎么说呢？他也是东方神灵，最好理解的是剑仙，当然他应该不像是，但意思差不多，至少是道士。西方的那些，怎么说呢，也算是敌对目标，所以，他对那群家伙，下手自然没这边这么温和，关键是，那么信仰冲突的前提下，图谋的自然不是咱们凡人管的。”
首长点头，大概明白情况，紫枫摸着下巴想想说：“我有个提议，你看昂，就现在的情况，韩家肯定要购物权，甚至是管理权。等谈判的时候，你们尽量坑，我叫管家单独分出一个智能机器人，专门给韩家人留着，等外国人来谈判，你就说，韩家的那个智能机器人，是海外分销商。这件事记得跟韩家人说明白，至于他们往不往外卖，那就是他们和那些外国人的事情啦。”
首长表示，这个可以有。紫枫想想说：“老外的话，你操作一把，看看能忽悠点古董回来不？至于抢劫这种事情，嘿嘿嘿。对啦，跟你家管网络的大哥说一声，如果有什么奇奇怪怪的资料，有用就看，没用就删。毕竟，这个算是彩蛋也是不错的。”
首长表示完全能处理，紫枫也就直接准备下一家。霖华仙尊也一直在哪里围观，确定这个孩子做好安排，才冒出声音：“行啦，抽新的系统。”
紫枫回答：“行吧，抽。”她面前出现一个新转盘，上面是密密麻麻的系统名字，她有种物理吐槽的感觉。
“叮，恭喜宿主获得白莲花系统。详情请观察系统更新，提示：请做好准备，在一个小时后，开启第一次穿越之旅。”
紫枫疑惑，但现在的话，她直冲超市，啥都不说了，米，面，调料，直接成箱往自己的随身空间堆，这样就算穿越到古代的世界，这些东西也能确保，她吃饭这个问题，是不会遇到的。锅碗瓢盆，也都安排好，帐篷、罐头、军刀什么的，也都搜刮一份带上。
content_en:
The leader asked sincerely: "Can we study them?"
Han Zifeng also replied sincerely: "Are you really afraid of these people who are waiting for food to tear down your home?" She turned around and asked one of the intelligent robot housekeepers: "Butler, do you have any intelligent robots for sale there? The kind that do research."
The butler replied: "Master, be confident. Whatever they dare to search for, as long as they have enough money, I can find it."
Zifeng's head twitched and asked: "Is there anything that can be used in reality, Doraemon's Any Door?"
The butler was silent. Immortal Lin Hua, who had been watching here, was also confused by the child's imagination. The butler said speechlessly: "Master, there is really no such thing. Also, those Pokémon and other things, golden holy clothes, etc., are not strong. Please, can you tell me something reliable? As for the holy clothes, they are also things like our Eastern God of War's armor, and the weapons are all cold weapons."
A group of people laughed unkindly, and six big words appeared in their minds: This is a matter of imagination.
Not to mention, the bosses came forward and the matter was settled quickly. As for the intelligent robot butler, he opened a small supermarket directly at No. 1 Long Street with the help of everyone. Zimo's useless things were sold directly on the counter.
For the rest, just use the computer to search, then go to the butler and pay to pick up the goods. There was just a big sign at the door: Han family members were not allowed to enter the store to purchase items.
When the Han family heard the news, they really felt regretful. It turned out that that girl meant this that day. But how are they going to deal with this now?
Zifeng saw that things here were almost settled, and Xiangxiang said to the few people who were stationed here to maintain order: "Please help me keep an eye on it. I'm going to start work. I hope you can come forward to settle the Han family's affairs. I don't want to see anything bad when I come back. Anyway, whether you can cover the vending machine or not is your problem."
A group of people nodded in unison, and Zifeng told the housekeeper: "If there is an accident, walk back and attack you in seconds. Don't tell me that you don't even know how to do this kind of dimensionality reduction attack. Okay, okay, get ready to start work." She asked directly in her mind: "Dear, I can resume work."
Immortal Linhua asked a little doubtfully: "Are you sure that this is enough?"
Zifeng said a little indifferently: "Those monks will not be polite to the Han family for the sake of a bite to eat. Even the Han family will not compromise easily for this benefit. However, these are their problems, as well as foreign forces. In other words, if you put a ban on the intelligent robot selling goods, even if there are differences in beliefs, in terms of cause and effect, you should not care, right?"
Immortal Linhua was confused: "What do you mean?"
Zifeng thought about it and said: "It's similar to the fight for faith. If those angel believers, lion dog believers, and stallion believers come here to buy things, can you use these to separate the beliefs of those gods? If you can do it, this can be spread throughout the world."
Immortal Lin Hua snapped his fingers and said: "Understood, this is really possible. I can put the seeds of karma on the things they buy."
Zifeng said calmly: "I'll watch and play, but if this is how it is played, then the place where this robot is now is a bit inappropriate." She thought for a moment and asked: "Dear, can we take Dark Star to do a wave of operations?"
Immortal Linhua asked with a smile: "Tell me what you think."
Zifeng said: "The next wave is a collection of formations. Well, it can be used to set up spirit gathering formations in a radius of thousands of miles. When the time comes, I will build a building and collect rent. This place can also receive foreign believers, so you can sell seeds."
Immortal Linhua nodded and said, "You can have this."
Zifeng said: "When work resumes later, I'll go say hello to the senior management here.After all, it would be bad to be misunderstood about something like this. "
Zifeng came to the chief, explained her thoughts to the chief, and said calmly: "Well, the person above me didn't give you benefits for nothing. Naturally, he has some things he wants. Either don't ask for these benefits, or give him what he wants. But for you mortals, what you can give is definitely worth the money. The point is, there is really nothing to worry about. It's hard to say whether you will get him or not. "
The chief asked: "Do those people in the West also receive this kind of treatment? "
Zifeng touched her chin and said, "No, no, no, what should I say? He is also an Eastern god, best understood as a swordsman. Of course, he shouldn't be like that, but the meaning is similar, at least he is a Taoist priest. Those in the West, how should I put it, can be regarded as hostile targets, so his attacks on those guys are naturally not as gentle as here. The key is, under the premise of conflict of beliefs, the plot is naturally not our mortals' business. "
The leader nodded, probably understanding the situation. Zifeng touched his chin and thought about it and said, "I have a proposal. Look, given the current situation, the Han family definitely wants shopping rights and even management rights. While waiting for negotiations, you try your best to cheat. I asked the housekeeper to separate a separate intelligent robot and keep it exclusively for the Han family. When foreigners come to negotiate, you can say that the Han family's intelligent robot is an overseas distributor. Remember to explain this matter clearly to the Han family. As for whether they go out for takeout, that is a matter between them and those foreigners. "
The chief said that this is possible. Zifeng thought about it and said: "For foreigners, you can try it out and see if you can get some antiques back? As for robbery, hey hey. By the way, tell your elder brother who is in charge of the Internet that if there is any weird information, read it if it is useful and delete it if it is not. After all, this is good as an Easter egg. "
The chief said that he could handle it completely, so Zifeng directly prepared for the next one. Linhua Immortal Lord has also been watching, making sure that the child has made arrangements before he says: "Okay, let's draw a new system. "
Zifeng replied: "Okay, smoke. "A new carousel appeared in front of her, with densely packed system names on it, and she felt like she was physically complaining.
"Ding, congratulations to the host for obtaining the White Lotus System. Please watch the system update for details. Tip: Please be prepared to start your first time-travel journey in an hour. "
Zifeng was confused, but now, she went straight to the supermarket without saying anything. Rice, noodles, and seasonings were piled directly into boxes in her carry-on space. This way, even if she traveled to the ancient world, these things would ensure that she would not encounter the problem of eating. The pots and pans were also arranged, and tents, cans, sabers, etc. were also collected and brought with them.
